name: ui-consumes-sdk-module
description: UI consuming an SDK module: list the specific files in src/ui/tsconfig.app.json include (like ../core/wire.ts), never the whole ../client dir — config-file.ts imports node:fs and breaks the DOM-lib composite build. Keep the SDK module's transitive closure on src/core/* only (ndjson.ts types its envelope against core/wire.ts ErrorEnvelope, not client/types.ts).

content: Renames must update: (1) src/ui-tests which read page files by name string (capability-layer.test.ts, lifecycle-poll-fallback.test.ts, ready-plans-tab.test.ts, plot-surface-removed.test.ts), and (2) the noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity override in biome.jsonc, which is keyed by path. Component identifiers stay PascalCase; only filenames change.

title: UI revamp planned as pl-7e38: Direction C operator console
rationale: Shell-first in-place rebuild beats a greenfield second UI package (bundle ratchet and dead-code guards would fight a parallel tree) and beats a token reskin (Direction C changes the IA). Forward-chained DAG keeps independent pages dispatchable while component-reuse pairs stay sequential.

name: direction-c-token-wiring
description: Direction C theming (warren-059a): tokens.css holds the verbatim canvas :root (dark base + --color-lt-* twins, fonts given fallback stacks), a :root[data-theme=light] remap plus a prefers-color-scheme no-attribute fallback, a compat layer aliasing legacy names (--color-fg/--color-card/--color-muted-foreground/-foreground inks) onto Direction C base names, and a @theme inline block (self-referencing var() entries are safe in inline mode — utilities get the var(), :root stays the single runtime source). Existing pages use only -(--color-*) arbitrary utilities, so no named color utilities needed re-mapping.

name: direction-c-console-shell
description: Direction C console shell lives in src/ui/src/components/console/ (shell, sidebar, topbar, nav defs, useConsoleStats). Sidebar counts bind to shared list query keys (['runs'], ['projects'], ['agents']) so the lifecycle stream invalidation refreshes them; BURN/RUNTIME figures stay '—' placeholders until the ops overview API (warren-d850). Page stubs use ComingPage naming the building issue. Structural guards in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts read source files by path — update them when moving components (warren-4ed7).

name: direction-c-page-structure
description: Direction C page pattern: page state in a use-<page>-state.ts hook (queries + mutation + default autofill), pure derivations in a separate view-model module (dispatch/manifest-view.ts), thin page component under 200 lines. Keeps Biome cognitive-complexity ceiling (15) and the 500-line file budget happy. Guard tests in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts hard-code page component names and the GATED_ELSEWHERE mutation-site allowlist — a page rename must update them in the same PR.

name: direction-c-page-rebuild
description: Direction C page rebuild pattern (pl-7e38 page issues): self-pad the page like coming-page.tsx (px-6 pt-[22px] pb-12 sm:px-[24px]) since ConsoleShell's <main> has no padding; split table/formatting helpers into a pages/<page>/ sibling dir to hold the 500-line budget; keep query keys prefixed with the list name (['runs', ...]) so use-lifecycle-stream-invalidation keeps working; source-level structural tests in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts pin exact strings (e.g. 'total: runs.data?.costTotalUsd,' and useOperatorHint("Dispatch one above.")) — check those before changing page copy; re-baseline bundle ratchet with check:bundle-size --update (auto-raise cap covers ~6KB page growth).

name: ui-revamp-page-rebuild
description: Direction C page rebuild pattern (warren-e228): source-regex guards in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts pin exact JSX shapes of pages — when a page redesign renames a component (AddProjectForm -> AddProjectDialog) update the test regexes in the same change; keep OperatorOnly admin-wrapping of RefreshProjectsCTA literal to satisfy the caller-gated-leaf guard.

name: direction-c-page-translation
description: Direction C pages translate Paper exports (docs/ui-revamp/screens/*.jsx) into Tailwind arbitrary-value classes like text-(--color-text-3)/bg-(--color-primary) so both themes come from tokens.css; login page (warren-9297) is the reference for a rebuilt page, incl. gating spectator affordances on GET /instance authMode instead of guessing

name: instance-facts-page-binding
description: Direction C Instance page binds GET /instance via metaApi.instance; the spectator (public auth) response omits operator-only fields (dbBackend, uptimeSeconds, admission), so pages treat them optional and render quiet '—' placeholders. Instance wire types live in src/ui/src/api/instance-types.ts because api/types.ts is at its frozen 776-line size budget.

name: direction-c-page-layout
description: Direction C page pattern for src/ui: split page into pages/<name>.tsx + pages/<name>/ dir with a draft module (pure state/build-input), a state hook (queries + mutation), a form component split into per-section subcomponents (keeps Biome cognitive-complexity ≤15), and a manifest rail reusing ../dispatch/manifest-view.ts helpers (repositoryLabel, buildAdmissionRows). useMutation without OperatorOnly import must be allowlisted in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts GATED_ELSEWHERE when the mutation lives in a route-gated page state hook (see walk-state.ts, warren-02bb).

name: direction-c-page-directory
description: Direction C run detail (warren-8c85): each rebuilt page lives in pages/<name>/ as a directory (index.tsx composes, panels split to stay under the 500-line budget); biome.jsonc's noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity override list only shrinks, so new code must be decomposed into per-phase/per-panel helpers rather than added to the exception list. formatCostUsd is single-sourced in pages/run-detail-format.ts — import it there, never from a page module's re-export.

name: walk-inspector-detail-page
description: Plan-run detail pages (warren-2520) reuse the ["plan-runs", id] query key so the inventory's per-row detail fetch and the lifecycle stream invalidation share one cache entry; Direction C rail/panel components are plain bordered sections (41px header rows, token-variable colors) instead of shadcn Card wrappers.

name: ui-response-envelopes-in-client
description: warren-24b9: new UI response envelopes go in src/ui/src/api/client.ts (like the analytics types), because src/ui/src/api/types.ts is at its frozen 776-line check:size budget. Wire enums stay as core/wire re-exports in types.ts (EVENT_STREAMS/EventStream added there). UI helper modules exercised by bun test must import relatively — the @/ alias fails under the repo-root runner. Dense evidence-row pages: extract filter strip + rows panel into sub-components to stay under Biome's cognitive-complexity ceiling.

name: ops-overview-page-pattern
description: Operations page (pl-7e38 step 13, warren-d903): one GET /ops/overview poll feeds capacity/services/lifecycle/interventions; render operator-only sections on FIELD PRESENCE from the reduced public projection, never on capability guesses — absent !== zero (warren-f53e). Shared ["runs"] newest-runs window (limit 200) dedupes with the shell and gets lifecycle-stream invalidation for free; do NOT open a second /events/stream connection (one-per-tab rule, warren-f566) — the events panel is a quiet placeholder until warren-5eec. UI wire envelopes that would push a frozen-ceiling file over budget split into src/ui/src/api/<domain>-types.ts (ops-types.ts follows run-analytics-types.ts). Repo-root bun test resolves no @/ alias: type-only @/ imports are fine, runtime VALUE imports need relative paths (mx-2e4a1a).

name: extension-surface-fetch-outside-client
description: Direction C Telemetry consolidation (warren-7197): optional-extension HTTP surfaces (judge /verdicts.jsonl) are consumed by a plain fetch in a page-local hook (src/ui/src/pages/telemetry/judge-verdicts.tsx), NOT via src/ui/src/api/client.ts — check:client-contract fails any client.ts path the warren ROUTE_TABLE doesn't serve, and extension awareness must not leak into core. Absent/401/network states are normal conditions rendered as quiet panels, never error banners. Shared tab state across child routes belongs in the layout route (it stays mounted across Outlet switches), not URL search params (NavLink drops them).

name: direction-c-responsive-inventory-cards
description: Direction C responsive pass (warren-dea8): the mobile arm of an inventory table is a shared inventory-card component (components/ui/inventory-card.tsx) rendering compact artboard row cards inside the page's existing bordered container below md; rails already stack via base flex-col + lg:flex-row; page gutters are px-3.5 md:px-6. Bundle growth re-baselines with check:bundle-size --update, never hand-edit.

name: ui-legacy-teardown-sweep
description: Legacy UI teardown (pl-7e38 step 21): knip full-run Unused-files list is the sweep inventory even though check:deps only gates dependencies. tokens.css legacy-name alias layer is still live (Direction C components reference --color-fg/--color-card), so the compat block is not dead until those renames happen.

Direction C bug sweep (pl-3ce8): judge tab reported 'extension not deployed' on a live judge because judge-verdicts.ts fetched /verdicts.jsonl same-origin with VITE_JUDGE_BASE_URL defaulting to '' — warren's SPA catch-all (src/server/ui.ts) answers ANY unmatched GET with 200 + index.html, so res.ok passed, HTML lines failed the swallowed JSON.parse, and zero rows was misread as absent. Any UI fetch outside the api client to a path warren does not serve will silently receive the SPA shell as a 200; probes must check content-type, and optional-extension surfaces need a warren-side proxy route registered ahead of the catch-all (CSP is connect-src 'self', so cross-origin cannot work).
resolution: pl-3ce8 steps: warren-side reverse-proxy route for the judge export holding JUDGE_EXPORT_TOKEN server-side (warren-1b40), client content-type/empty-page classification with honest per-state copy (warren-f927), k8s env wiring (warren-a309).

name: mobile-mock-conformance-map
description: Direction C 375px conformance ground truth: docs/ui-revamp/screens/mobile/*.jsx (7 artboards; Paper canvas unreachable — the export is authoritative). Shared chrome = 48px brand bar + 34px HEALTHY/RUN/QUE/BURN strip + 54px five-tab bottom nav (01 Operations · 02 Runs · 03 Dispatch · 06 Telemetry · ·· More, 2px active top border) — none of it implemented as of pl-4ab6 creation; shell ships hamburger+drawer. Key audit findings: sm/md breakpoints are stock (640/768) so 375px sits below every sm: arm; runs/plan-runs/active-workloads trap loading/error/empty states in hidden md:block; operations rows with min-w-0 zero-basis children never trigger flex-wrap; responsive.ts (warren-3315 contract: responsiveFormControl 16px/44px, PHONE_MIN 360) has zero importers so every control iOS-zooms; dispatch resolved-manifest.tsx w-[350px] overflows (twin walk-manifest.tsx:161 has the fix). Mobile plan pl-4ab6 (25 children) tracks the conformance pass with cross-plan deps on pl-3ce8.

name: first-run-onboarding-gate
description: First-run onboarding (warren-a911): pure setup.helpers.ts gate + buildSetupSteps driven by live query counts; index route renders checklist only for undismissed operators with zero projects; /github-app/register links must be plain <a> (server HTML page, not a hash route); bundle auto-raise within cap needs committed budget diff

name: repo-picker-capability-arm
description: Repo picker (warren-2601): UI branches on the GET /forge/repos 'supported' discriminant (200 body, never an error status); pure helpers in add-project-repo-picker.helpers.ts decide picker vs paste-only and cap rendered rows at 50; URL paste never goes away so repos the App cannot see stay addable. Envelope types declared in client.ts per the ui-response-envelopes-in-client pattern.

name: telemetry-mobile-stacked-arm
description: Telemetry mobile chrome (warren-93cc): below md the tab page flattens — TelemetryPage redirects deep links to /telemetry via a matchMedia(min-width:768px) hook, renders all four tab components in a md:hidden stack (economics kept behind OperatorOnly readOperator to mirror its route guard), and the index child redirect must be viewport-gated too or parent/child Navigate bounce infinitely. The hidden range selector's window surfaces as TelemetryPanel header meta (panel pulls useTelemetryWindow, prefixes '14D · ' below md). Bundle growth from the stacked arm re-baselines cleanly via rm -rf src/ui/node_modules + check:bundle-size --update.

name: mobile-filter-strip-extraction
description: Mobile filter-strip pattern (warren-6419): extract both responsive renderings into pages/<page>/<page>-filter-bar.tsx — below-md overflow-x pill strip reusing FilterPill with twMerge-overridden radius/padding, md+ markup kept byte-identical behind hidden md:flex. Re-baseline bundle budgets only after rm -rf src/ui/node_modules.

title: Run-detail mobile section order and breakpoint policy (warren-3399)
rationale: The two-column row needs xl width, but phone treatments on 768-1279 made tablet look like a stretched phone; gating order+collapses below md keeps the mid-range at desktop weight while 375px gets the mock order

name: ui-root-test-pure-helpers
description: warren-f8a2: pure card cell/subline logic for UI inventory cards goes in a sibling <name>.helpers.ts (no runtime @/ imports, only import type) so it stays testable under the repo-root bun test, which resolves neither the @/ alias nor src/ui/node_modules; see runs-card.helpers.ts + labels.test.ts for the same constraint.

name: telemetry-mobile-meter-arms
description: Telemetry mobile arms (warren-756e/pl-4ab6): below-md table replacements render as MeterBar rows gated with md:hidden/hidden md:block pairs inside TelemetryPanel bodies; per-surface fixed label/value widths pass through MeterBar's labelClass/valueClass using mobile-first arbitrary classes (w-[118px] md:w-24) so twMerge cannot reorder them. The loop daily outcome chart bucket-collapses to Monday-keyed weekly buckets below md via the shared useIsDesktop hook (hoisted to src/ui/src/pages/telemetry/use-is-desktop.ts) — 90D daily columns otherwise force ~626px into a 347px box.

name: telemetry-judge-mobile-distribution
description: Telemetry judge tab mobile conformance (warren-a293): below-md degradation composes the shared InventoryCardList/InventoryRowCard arm for the failed-verdict table (dot-only tone: danger for failing verdicts, neutral for unjudged markers; failing-class label on the meta line) plus a mock-conformant stacked 8px segment bar + wrapped swatch legend + top-failure-class summary row (JudgeDistributionMobile) replacing the bare pass/fail/unjudged spans; gate the per-class MeterBar list md+ since the judge panel degrades without meter rows.

name: ui-hash-routing-live-instance
description: app.warren.run UI is hash-routed (HashRouter): SPA pages live at /#/runs, /#/plan-runs, etc. Plain paths like /runs collide with the JSON API routes and return API JSON, not the SPA. For browser automation/screenshots against a live instance, navigate to https://app.warren.run/#/<route>. Spectator (WARREN_AUTH=public) renders all pages read-only without a token.

React minified error #290 ('Element ref was specified as a string but no owner was set') on a page means a component prop literally named 'ref' is being passed a string — 'ref' is a reserved JSX prop and never reaches function-component props. Dispatch page shipped ref={s.draft.ref} (the git ref draft string) in #1083; ui:dev rendered fine because the dev JSX runtime handles the reserved prop differently, so only the production bundle crashed.
resolution: Rename the domain prop (gitRef, commit 9aaa95fd). When triaging #290, grep 'ref=' in JSX for any domain field named ref.

title: UI patches: header, operations, runs, run detail, plan-runs, projects, agents, telemetry (2026-09 operator review)
rationale: Twenty children grouped by page, with UI-only fixes first and additive wire changes stacked behind them so the visible defects land in the first PRs. Each child title carries the file:line sites and the root cause so a dispatched agent can start without re-scouting. Copy fixes ride inside the page child that already touches the file; a final sweep child covers the pages no other child opens. Spectator exposure follows the existing classification pattern (PUBLIC_*/REDACTED_* field lists + pickFields + the public-projections partition test), and every widening is fenced by scenario 39. Two policy calls are made explicitly rather than by omission: spend in USD stays operator-only on /ops/overview (the analytics redaction lists and scenario 39's FORBIDDEN_FIELD_NAMES already say aggregate USD is private; spectators get delivery counts and runs-in-window instead), and the overall cost-per-merged-PR ratio becomes public on /analytics/runs with the buckets kept redacted and scenario 39 hardened to walk that subtree. Stage timing gets real columns (workspace_ready_at, agent_ready_at, agent_ended_at, reaped_at) written at the moments the runtime already observes, rather than more event-stream heuristics. The judge extension's malformed_verdict flood is filed as a live investigation child, not guessed at from the repo.

description: warren-17d7: the public plan-runs projection strips REDACTED_PLAN_RUN_FIELDS but src/ui/src/api/types.ts typed them required, so spectators crashed (formatCostUsd(undefined).toFixed) on walk-row/walk-cards/detail-rail.
resolution: Mirror redacted server fields as optional (?) in the UI types, widen display formatters to accept null|undefined and return an em-dash, and use == null / != null (not === null) at every read site so 'absent' and 'null' render identically. Server projection unchanged. Also: a fresh workspace needs bun install at root AND in src/ui plus extensions/judge, or typecheck/coverage gates fail with phantom module errors.

description: bun test cannot resolve @/ tsconfig paths for runtime imports under src/ui (only type-only imports survive erasure) — UI test files must import modules whose runtime imports are relative paths
resolution: switch touched modules' runtime imports to relative paths (see runs-table.tsx / runs-format.ts)
